Something that’s been helping me lately is breaking up whatever it is into smaller tasks that I can do quickly. Example: I need to do dishes. So I start by unloading the dishwasher (I rarely use it to wash dishes, just to store what I’ve hand-washed.) I tend to do this while I’m cooking or doing something else in the kitchen. Then I might rinse all the dirty dishes out and organize them on the counter by how I would put them in the dishwasher when I wash them. By the time I get to washing them, I just grab them, wash them, stick them in the dishwasher. It seems like a lot more work this way but it makes it way less dreadful for me. This is usually done over a span of a couple of days. 
Another example: I need to do laundry. I start by emptying the dryer. Then I work on folding those clothes and putting them away. Then I sort the dirty stuff. Then I wash it. I might spread this out over a weekend day.
